title: Live CTFlow compatibility is partially verified, but a hard provider spending bound and scientific runner are absent
evidence: The official CTFlow documentation page was fetched over HTTPS and documents the tested base, catalog, chat route, and Bearer authentication.
A same-origin unauthenticated catalog probe returned HTTP 401; authenticated discovery returned 243 exact model IDs.
Minimal live generation preflight passed for qwen3.5-plus and glm-5.2 and failed for deepseek-v3.2.
The user's explicit USD 200 ceiling is now recorded in the matrix config, but CTFlow does not expose verifiable pricing or billing semantics in the documentation.
The matrix still fails closed because no validated scientific runner or runner-level hard budget contract exists.
not_a_resolution: The minimal preflight is not a G0-G7 scientific evaluation.
No formal G7 rows, scientific scores, or causal conclusions were generated.
The failed DeepSeek preflight was not silently converted to a usable model.
required_next_evidence: Provider-verifiable price/usage or billing export sufficient for a conservative hard USD cap.
A thin, tested adapter to the existing scientific runner with exact paired LLM-only/Agent result contracts.
Independent isolation and mathematical/statistical review before formal release.
